items.title: ESC 2026: Evidence supporting SGLT2 inhibitors and finerenone in heart failure grows
items.summary: Several treatment guidelines worldwide recommend the use of SGLT2 inhibitors as a treatment for all types of heart failure.

items.title: ESC 2026: Aficamten breaks new ground in nonobstructive HCM
items.summary: Aficamten improves cardiac structure and diastolic function, strengthening its case as a targeted therapy for nonobstructive HCM.

items.title: ESC 2026: Evolocumab explores new frontiers in CV disease prevention
items.summary: The benefits of intensive LDL-C lowering with Repatha (evolocumab) may extend beyond cardiovascular event prevention to reducing mortality.

items.title: Teva Pharmaceuticals to acquire BioXcel assets for up to $125m
items.summary: Teva Pharmaceuticals International has made a bid to acquire a range of neuroscience assets from BioXcel Therapeutics for a total deal value of $125m.

items.title: ESC 2026: Statins show worth despite emergence of PCSK9 inhibitors
items.summary: The Australia-based STAREE trial is the first of its kind demonstrating the preventative effects of statins in older patients.
